artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2E - Final Research Decision Register

Frozen_E0.justification: Production reference implementation. Validated across full corporate-action replay; zero regressions in core engine.

Execution_Safe_Agent_Final.justification: Provides deterministic cash affordability, sell-first execution sequencing, and double-entry balance sheet conservation without altering strategy economics.

Candidate_D1_Energy_Exit.justification: Marginal drawdown reduction does not offset loss of diversification; fails to provide superior risk-adjusted profile to D2.

Candidate_D2_Cash_Cushion.justification: Strongest risk-mitigation candidate. Reduces Tier 2 MaxDD by 10.55 percentage points (from 31.75% to 21.20%) via 50% explicit cash cushion in defensive mode, with minimal Tier 1 return drag.

Candidate_D3_Recovery_Discipline.formal_verdict: INVESTIGATE ONLY WITH NEW INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Candidate_D3_Recovery_Discipline.justification: High recovery returns on Tier 2, but degrades Tier 1 MaxDD relative to baseline E0. Requires out-of-sample stress verification.

Candidate_C1_Tight_Vol_Gate.formal_verdict: INVESTIGATE ONLY WITH NEW INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Candidate_C1_Tight_Vol_Gate.justification: Cuts overlay participation prematurely during bull pullbacks; lacks consistent regime separation.

Candidate_C2_Vol_Acceleration.justification: Severe whipsaw churn, elevated transaction costs, and substantial return drag across both Tier 1 and Tier 2.

Candidate_C3_Vol_Persistence.justification: Completely economically inactive in historical data; zero state transitions triggered on SPY.

Candidate_C4_Combined_Gates.justification: Inherits severe churn penalties from C2; multi-parameter complexity without alpha justification.

Candidate_P1_Inverse_Vol.justification: Extreme compounding drag (drops Tier 2 CAGR by 11.52% and Tier 1 CAGR by 5.52%) with negligible crash protection.

Candidate_P2_Capped_Inverse_Vol.justification: Fails to resolve compounding drag; penalizes high-momentum leaders.

Candidate_P3_Smoothed_Inverse_Vol.justification: EWMA smoothing introduces lag; fails to improve Sharpe or drawdown meaningfully.

Candidate_P4_Blend_Equal_Inverse.justification: Most balanced position-sizing candidate, achieving 16.59% MaxDD in Tier 1. Retained as reference for risk-budgeting studies.

formal_governance_answers.1_strongest_supported_weakness_in_e0: The 130% gross economic exposure during Risk-On (70% tech momentum + 60% embedded 2x leveraged ETFs) combined with an 18-session moving average lag creates severe left-tail vulnerability during sudden market dislocations (31.75% Tier 2 MaxDD). In addition, positive correlation of the defensive XLE sleeve during commodity/demand crashes exacerbates drawdowns.
formal_governance_answers.2_conclusively_corrected: Three major structural items: (1) Cash-affordability and execution safety resolved via sell-first sequencing and double-entry broker accounting (Stage 2A-F); (2) Historical financial baseline reconciled to 0.00 residual by modeling corporate actions (Stage 2B-R); (3) Overlay measurement integrity verified, proving overlay was fully operational (283 holding days in Tier 2) and the '0% overlay' claim was purely a reporting artifact (Stage 2D-R).
formal_governance_answers.3_unjustified_for_promotion: Candidates D1, C1, C2, C4, P1, P2, P3 did not justify promotion due to either heavy churn, excessive return drag, or negligible drawdown reduction.
formal_governance_answers.4_ideas_deserving_further_investigation: Candidate D2 (50% explicit cash cushion in Risk-Off) which cleanly cuts Tier 2 MaxDD from 31.75% to 21.20% with minimal drag, and Candidate D3 (recovery discipline) for faster post-crash upside capture.
formal_governance_answers.5_risks_untestable_on_authorized_data: Regime changes where long bonds (TLT) crash simultaneously with equities (e.g. 2022 inflation shock), intraday flash crashes, and overnight gap events in 2x leveraged ETFs.
formal_governance_answers.6_reliable_path_to_validation: Forward paper simulation or strictly governed single-shot verification on sealed Tier 3 data (>= 2022-01-01) AFTER freezing a candidate. Historical backtesting on Tier 1/2 is fully exhausted and statistically contaminated.
formal_governance_answers.7_justification_to_reopen_rejected_candi: Reopening volatility gates would require proven predictive power of leading volatility indicators without churn. Reopening inverse-vol sizing would require proof of CVaR reduction exceeding compounding drag.
formal_governance_answers.8_recommended_focus_next_stage: Research closure and risk-budget monitoring. Transition candidate D2 to forward paper simulation protocol while keeping production agent frozen. Zero further historical parameter tuning on Tier 1/2.
